basic_details.job_title: NHM MP Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Senior Public Health Consultant, Hub Engineer Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Public Health Consultant, Hub Engineer
basic_details.short_information: National Health Mission Madhya Pradesh (NHM MP) Recruitment 2026: National Health Mission Madhya Pradesh has released the official notification for 3 Senior Public Health Consultant, Hub Engineer posts, inviting applications from eligible candidates in Madhya Pradesh. This recruitment provides an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking stable and well-paid government jobs.

application_fee.all_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age as on 01-04-2026. Age relaxation details are not specified in the provided data. Please refer to the official notification.

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS with MBA/MPH/MD or equivalent, B.Tech/B.E in Computer Science/Electronics/IT with networking certifications
qualification.details: Senior Public Health Consultant: MBBS Recognized by NMC with MBA in Disaster Management/Healthcare Administration/Hospital Administration/Hospital & Health Management OR Master of Public Health (MPH) OR Master in Hospital Administration OR Post-graduate or diploma in disaster management/Medicine/Public Health Management OR MD Community Medicine/Community Health Administration/Hospital Administration/Preventive and Social Medicine/Internal Medicine/Anesthesia/Emergency Medicine from a recognized university. Minimum 10 years experience in implementing Public Health Programs with focus on emergency/disaster management. Hub Engineer: B.Tech/B.E degree in Computer Science/Computer Application/Electronics & Communication/Information Technology (Regular course from recognized college/university). Mandatory: Certifications related to networking. At least 2 years experience in similar role. Experience with security protocols and information systems. Proficiency in managing and troubleshooting complete ICT networks and systems. Strong understanding of telecommunication technologies.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,20,000/- (Senior Public Health Consultant), Rs. 40,000/- (Hub Engineer)
salary_details.details: Senior Public Health Consultant: Rs. 1,20,000/- Hub Engineer: Rs. 40,000/-

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM MP Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM MP to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NHM MP Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Public Health Consultant: MBBS Recognized by NMC with MBA in Disaster Management/Healthcare Administration/Hospital Administration/Hospital & Health Management OR Master of Public Health (MPH) OR Master in Hospital Administration OR Post-graduate or diploma in disaster management/Medicine/Public Health Management OR MD Community Medicine/Community Health Administration/Hospital Administration/Preventive and Social Medicine/Internal Medicine/Anesthesia/Emergency Medicine from a recognized university. Minimum 10 years experience in implementing Public Health Programs with focus on emergency/disaster management. Hub Engineer: B.Tech/B.E degree in Computer Science/Computer Application/Electronics & Communication/Information Technology (Regular course from recognized college/university). Mandatory: Certifications related to networking. At least 2 years experience in similar role. Experience with security protocols and information systems. Proficiency in managing and troubleshooting complete ICT networks and systems. Strong understanding of telecommunication technologies.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NHM MP Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM MP to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM MP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NHM MP Recruitment 2026 is 16 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NHM MP Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Senior Public Health Consultant and Hub Engineer in the NHM MP Recruitment 2026.

faq.answer: The educational qualification for Senior Public Health Consultant includes MBBS with MBA/MPH/MD or equivalent, along with a minimum of 10 years of experience in public health programs.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in NHM MP Recruitment 2026 is 45 years, as of 01 April 2026.

faq.answer: The application mode for NHM MP Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.answer: The salary for the Hub Engineer post in NHM MP Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.answer: The selection process for NHM MP Recruitment 2026 will be based on a Merit List and an Interview.
